verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA DGX B200 is on-premises GPU server hardware that runs the customer's own workloads. A training-data opt-out is a privacy control for hosted AI services that collect user data, so the question is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the B200 collecting user data for vendor model training or offering such a control, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
